development_loader: Explicit train/validation enum only; resolve and validate path under ml_v4/data/development/<partition>; reject aliases, traversal, symlinks escaping root, wildcard roots and evaluation requests. Holdout files not mounted in development process.
evaluation_loader: Separate evaluation-only entry point requires recorded user authorization, frozen model/preprocessor/feature/threshold hashes and matching seal. Log requester, scope, UTC, artifact hashes and operation; reject fitting and writeback to sealed inputs.
final: Same design distribution, horizon, unit size and opportunity laws as Train/Validation, with disjoint entities and independent streams.
final_access: One declared final evaluation after all development/threshold decisions. Independent evaluation is a second predeclared report under identical frozen model; neither feeds retraining. If final results drive later work, future version needs fresh holdouts.
freshness: Completely new V4 Final Test and Independent Evaluation, including histories, entities, labels and commitments. No V3 evaluation directory enumeration or byte access; no reinterpretation of V3 evaluation labels.
independent_agent_allocation: Uniformly permute the 16 archetypes with the stated exact counts, then assign8 to each of the 2 independent units; unit sizes remain unchanged.

independent_shift.amount_bounds: Same[0.01,15000]USD and rounding; truncate by rejection after multiplying. All origins use shift.
independent_shift.interpretation: Joint moderate synthetic process shift; does not isolate causal effects of individual shifted factors. Not designed from model weaknesses or to maximize failure.

provenance: Separate private diagnostics, never passed to model prediction. Custodian can compute predeclared slices after authorization without leaking provenance to X.
seal: Authorized custodian creates data once after approved implementation. Hash all new holdout raw/target/history files in its isolated environment; publish commitment root, schema/design hashes and fixed gate certificate only. Private file manifest and seeds held separately with no developer access. Stage 15 creates no holdout files or seal.
status: DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and population evidence pending
